offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Top-up 模式，无月度订阅：Starter $50/50k credits ($1.00/1k)；Standard $375/500k ($0.75/1k)；Scale $1250/2.5M ($0.50/1k)；Ultimate $3750/12.5M ($0.30/1k)
offerings.price_basis: Starter（最低公开档，$50 充值 50,000 次查询）；更大充值档价更低，低至 $0.30/1k（Ultimate）
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries（No credit card required）
offerings.note: 每次成功查询扣 1 credit，credits 有效期 6 个月；结果 1-2 秒返回，实时查 Google 不缓存；各档位并发 50-300 QPS；付费档不含税（* Excluding sales tax/VAT/GST）；7 天内未用超 20% credits 可全额退款
